output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# make set type matrix
```{r}
# Load fitted models
model_files <- list.files("models/", pattern = "best_model\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
response_names <- gsub("_best_model\\.rds$", "", basename(model_files))
models <- setNames(lapply(model_files, readRDS), response_names)

# Extract set type random effects
extract_settype <- function(model){
  coefs <- coef(model)
  vals <- coefs[grep("^s\\(set_type\\)", names(coefs))]
  names(vals) <- sub("^s\\(set_type\\)\\.", "", names(vals))
  vals
}

settype_effects <- lapply(models, extract_settype)

# Remove responses with no set type effect
settype_effects <- settype_effects[sapply(settype_effects, function(x) any(x != 0))]

# Set type × response matrix
settype_matrix <- do.call(cbind, settype_effects)

dim(settype_matrix)
sort(apply(settype_matrix, 2, sd))
```

## PCA
```{r}
pca_settypes <- prcomp(settype_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

scores_settypes <- data.frame(pca_settypes$x)
scores_settypes$set_type <- rownames(scores_settypes)

loadings <- data.frame(pca_settypes$rotation)
loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)

# Variance explained
var_exp <- 100 * (pca_settypes$sdev^2) / sum(pca_settypes$sdev^2)
var_exp[1:2]
```

## scree plot
```{r}
# Scree plot
scree_df <- data.frame(PC = seq_along(var_exp), Variance = var_exp)

ggplot(scree_df, aes(PC, Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Principal component",
       y = "Variance explained %") +
  theme_bw()
```

## hierarchical clustering
```{r}

d <- dist(pca_settypes$x)
hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")

# look at dendrogram
plot(hc, xlab = "", sub = "") # looks like 3

# Compare the 2 v. 3 cluster solutions
plot(hc)
rect.hclust(hc, k = 2, border = "red")

plot(hc)
rect.hclust(hc, k = 3, border = "blue")

# Silhouette widths for alternative numbers of clusters
sapply(2:5, function(k){
  cl <- cutree(hc, k)
  mean(silhouette(cl, d)[,3])
})
# Silhouette widths are low for all solutions -> weak separation among clusters
# choose the 3 cluster one based on major branch structure in the dendrogram
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = 3)

scores_settypes$cluster <- factor(
  clusters[match(scores_settypes$set_type, names(clusters))])

scores_settypes[, c("set_type", "cluster")]

```
